name: edrTotalServerCount
definition: The number of servers in the endpoint inventory that requiredCoveragePercentage divides by, in an EDR coverage transform.
population: servers. Class rule per vendor: CrowdStrike product_type_desc Server or Domain Controller (product_type 3 or 2 when the description is absent); SentinelOne machineType server; Defender osPlatform containing 'server' or any Linux distribution (ruling 2026-10-16). The denominator and the protected test are exactly the ones the same transform uses for requiredCoveragePercentage, so the split agrees with the blended figure.
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete read of the device inventory. Null when the read is partial or failed.

changeLog.change: Registered with the EDR server / workstation coverage split added to four EDR coverage transforms under edr* names (additive; no requirement reads it yet).

notes: Supporting count for the server / workstation coverage split; not a criterion on its own today.
